sources.name: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet)
sources.attribution: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), CC BY 4.0
sources.notes: Monthly averages in nominal USD. The landing page links its data licensing to the CC BY 4.0 section of the Data Catalog. robots.txt on www.worldbank.org allows /en/research/; thedocs.worldbank.org has no robots.txt (404). The file URL changes with each release, so the collector reads it from the landing page.

sources.name: Banco Central do Brasil, SGS time series API
sources.attribution: Banco Central do Brasil, SGS (series 3698 and 189), ODbL
sources.notes: Series 3698: USD/BRL sell rate, monthly average. Series 189: IGP-M, monthly % change. The open data portal lists SGS series under ODbL. api.bcb.gov.br has no robots.txt (404). Since March 2025 JSON queries need a date range.

sources.name: US Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API
sources.notes: robots.txt on api.bls.gov disallows every path for every user agent, so producer price indexes are not collected from it.
